author: @mike2307

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking change. The fix restores the documented option priority (load request overrides recipe_options.json, but now the load request correctly reflects what was saved). Models without a saved ctx_size load exactly as before. The omni exclusion and non-custom paths are unchanged.
evidence.documentation: The PR declares documentation is not affected. The behavior change restores what was always documented (the option priority chain: load request → recipe_options.json → architecture defaults → global config) but was unreachable for GUI-initiated custom model loads. No docs needed for a bug fix that corrects implementation to match the spec.
evidence.manual_release_testing: No manual release test to-do required. This is a bug fix restoring documented behavior (saved ctx_size from recipe_options.json), not a new feature. The bundled runtime regression test exercises the actual function under test with full webpack bundling, covering all edge cases that a user would encounter. The change is confined to a single client-side function in customModelStore.ts (10 lines changed, 1 deleted).
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after the first (and only) approval at 2026-10-30T23:13:54Z. The PR had two commits — the fix and the regression test — both authored by @mike2307 and both present before approval.
evidence.review: PR #4020 was opened by @mike2307 and approved by @fl0rianr at 2026-10-30T23:13:54Z with 'Thanks, nice fix. Approved.' CodeRabbit (bot) flagged a potential issue: the original draft used Number() coercion on recipe_options.ctx_size, which would treat the string 'Infinity' as valid. The author addressed this in the final commit by switching to typeof check plus Number.isInteger, which is even more robust. @fl0rianr's subject area includes GUI, so the reviewer had relevant expertise. Only one review comment from an automated bot was posted; no substantive human review comments were raised. The review was brief but the change is minimal and self-evident.
evidence.security: No security concern. The change is a small logic fix in a TypeScript client-side function. It reads a numeric field from saved recipe options and applies a typeof/type guard. No credential handling, network calls, code execution, or permission changes.
evidence.tests: New file src/app/tests/custom-load-options.runtime.cjs (93 lines) bundles customModelStore.ts via webpack and exercises customLoadOptions() with a comprehensive set of assertions: saved integer ctx_size survives max_context_window override, the -1 auto sentinel is preserved, missing ctx_size falls back to max_context_window, non-integer saved values (strings, booleans, null, NaN, 0, 12288.5) fall back to the default, omni models stay unaffected, and non-custom models keep the previous no-op. The test uses the same bundle approach as the existing router-store.runtime.cjs and is picked up by CI's npm run test:runtime (39/39 pass).

subject: fix(gui3): honor saved ctx_size when loading custom models (#4019) (#4020)
summary: Fixes gui3 so that loading custom models from the web app honors the saved ctx_size from recipe_options.json instead of unconditionally overwriting it with the model's max_context_window.
verdict_reason: A well-scoped one-line logic fix with a thorough bundled regression test, reviewed by a GUI subject-matter expert, with all CI checks passing and no post-approval commits.
